description: The line plot compares the performance of different query selection strategies for document expansion in dense retrieval, measured by MRR@10 on the MS-MARCO dev set. The x-axis represents the number of queries used during inference, ranging from 1 to 10, while the y-axis shows the MRR@10 score, ranging from 33.0 to 36.5. Each strategy is represented by a distinct line style and color: DPR w/o query (black solid), DPR w/ gold (yellow solid), DPR w/ top-1 (green solid), DPR w/ bottom-1 (purple solid), DPR w/ random (blue solid), and DPR w/ curriculum (red solid). The solid lines represent results with corpus expansion, and the dotted lines of the same color represent the typical representation (no expansion). The performance of all strategies generally increases with the number of queries used during inference. The red solid line (DPR w/ curriculum) starts at approximately 35.0 MRR@10 and rises to about 35.7, while the green solid line (DPR w/ top-1) shows a sharp increase from 33.0 to 36.4. The yellow solid line (DPR w/ gold) remains relatively flat, starting at 33.0 and ending at 35.0. The purple solid line (DPR w/ bottom-1) starts at 34.9 and ends at 34.8, showing a slight decline. The blue solid line (DPR w/ random) starts at 34.9 and ends at 35.1, with a slight increase. The black solid line (DPR w/o query) remains constant at 34.5 across all values of the x-axis. The dotted lines for each strategy show a similar trend to their corresponding solid lines but at a lower MRR@10 value, indicating that corpus expansion improves performance.
